description: One AutoSEO article by `id` (from list_articles): the row list_articles gives, plus its text as Cituna stores it (`title`, `metaTitle`, `metaDescription`, `dek`, `sections` as {h2, body}, `faqs` as {q, a}, `tags`), what the publishing checks flagged (`gateProblems`, `qualityNotes`) and the last refresh's before and after (`lastEnrich`). Read it before update_article, which replaces whole fields. Free, reads stored data.
name: get_article
